clue.text: Bottle for artist in the bistro

indicators.note: the word in tells us the artist's letters sit inside the eating place

parts.note: a bistro is a small cafe
RA is a Royal Academician, the usual crossword artist

explanation.surface: Someone wants a bottle brought over for a painter dining in a little French restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: A carafe is a glass vessel for serving wine or water at table.

clue.text: Turns the scales before the fight

definitions.text: Turns the scales before the fight

parts.words: Turns the scales before the fight
parts.note: a boxer or jockey has their body weight officially recorded ahead of the contest

explanation.definitionFit: Fighters are officially weighed on the day before a bout to confirm their division.

clue.text: Eligible period for member ship of the union

definitions.text: Eligible period for member ship of the union

parts.words: Eligible period for member ship of the union
parts.note: the union is wedlock, and the time of life when someone may lawfully join it

explanation.definitionFit: The legal minimum years at which a person may wed is the time they become eligible for wedlock.

clue.text: President tending to be resilient

parts.note: liable means apt or likely to do something

explanation.surface: A head of state is said to be inclined towards toughness.
explanation.definitionFit: Something supple and springy bends easily, which is what pliable means.

clue.text: Eminently spoken, there's nothing more to be said

definitions.text: Eminently spoken, there's nothing more to be said

parts.words: Eminently spoken, there's nothing more to be said
parts.note: celebrated final utterances of the great, after which nothing further was said

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names well-known final remarks, often ironically for an overconfident claim.

clue.text: It's rum in a way, though self-evident

definitions.note: adjective defining a noun: a statement that is self-evident

indicators.note: in a way suggests the letters are arranged in another fashion

explanation.surface: Something is odd in one sense, yet perfectly obvious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a way' rearranges ITSRUM. The definition is an adjective standing for a noun meaning a self-evident statement.
explanation.definitionFit: A truism is a statement so obviously true it hardly needs saying.

clue.text: Warm-up race

explanation.definitionFit: To warm something up is to heat it, and a qualifying round of a race is a heat.

clue.text: Blow strong enough to break a leg

indicators.note: breaking the short phrase smashes its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A wind so fierce that it could snap someone's limb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' rearranges ALEG; 'Break a leg' is also the theatrical good-luck wish.
explanation.definitionFit: A gale is a very strong wind, a blow of force eight or more.

clue.text: Large deal contrived in concert

indicators.note: contrived means artfully arranged, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A big business agreement was engineered at a musical performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' rearranges LARGEDEAL into the two-word answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means together, with everyone in full accord.

clue.text: See 9
Edible firework?

parts.note: a loud cracker that shares its name with the British slang for a sausage

explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a sausage is slangily called by the same name as a noisy firecracker.

clue.text: Makes signs to a struggling group in the early Olympics

indicators.note: struggling letters are thrown about and come out in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone gestures towards a team battling at the ancient Games.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struggling' rearranges SIGNSTOA; 'Makes' only joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Greece the competitors in public games were called by this term, from agon, a contest.

clue.text: Restoration of building for military constructors?

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army corps that builds
an establishment is a building or institution

explanation.surface: Renovating a structure on behalf of army builders.
explanation.definitionFit: Restoring something means setting it up again, its re-founding.

clue.text: Can upset a stupid person

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means the word is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: a tin is a can

explanation.surface: A container may be knocked over by a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Nit is British slang for a fool or idiot, short for nitwit.

clue.text: Striking sail on the aftermast

explanation.definitionFit: A spanker is a striking or remarkably fine thing, and also the fore-and-aft sail set on a ship's rearmost mast.

clue.text: Level for the most part

indicators.note: most of a word means all of it but its final letter

explanation.walkthrough: 'most' drops the last letter of PART; 'for the' is link wording.
explanation.definitionFit: Par means equality or a standard level, as in 'on a par'.

clue.text: The way that leads to trouble

definitions.text: The way that leads to trouble

parts.words: The way that leads to trouble
parts.note: a route taken by those bent on battle or conflict

explanation.definitionFit: Being on this path means being angry and ready for a fight, originally a route of war parties.

clue.text: Discussed Anglo-French terms?

parts.note: held talks about peace terms, using a word English took from French parler, to speak

explanation.definitionFit: To parley is to negotiate with an opponent, a word borrowed from the French verb for speaking.

clue.text: Relevant to a Continental, note

parts.note: a German is a person from continental Europe
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Pertinent to a European, it says in a memo.
explanation.definitionFit: Germane means pertinent or bearing on the matter at hand.

clue.text: In any event there's little doubt he'll compete

definitions.text: In any event there's little doubt he'll compete

parts.words: In any event there's little doubt he'll compete
parts.note: event is a race, and this is the runner very likely to line up

explanation.definitionFit: A runner or horse likely to take part in a race is so described in form guides.

clue.text: Humble Scots dwelling-for two together, that is

parts.note: both means the two of them together
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A modest home in Scotland, built for a couple to share.
explanation.definitionFit: A bothy is a small hut or cottage in Scotland, also spelt this way.

clue.text: No right to enquire about the nature of horses

definitions.note: a noun phrase standing for an adjective meaning having that nature

indicators.note: about signals the remaining letters are moved around

explanation.surface: One has no business asking into how horses behave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No' takes R out of ENQUIRE, and 'about' rearranges what is left, ENQUIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Equine describes anything horselike, from Latin equus.

clue.text: Current opposition in the higher reaches

explanation.definitionFit: Going against the flow of a river is going this way, and the upper part of a river lies this way.

clue.text: Be mother for the French

explanation.definitionFit: To be mother in Britain is to serve the tea, and the French word for 'for' is pour.

clue.text: Type of dagger

parts.note: type means printing, and this dagger is a printer's mark rather than a blade

explanation.definitionFit: The obelus is the printer's dagger sign used for footnotes, or a division symbol.

clue.text: Contemplating employing miners' leader to start with

indicators.note: the miners' pick is placed at the front of the next piece
the leader of the word is its opening letter

parts.note: using means employing

explanation.surface: Considering hiring the head of the mineworkers' union first.
explanation.definitionFit: Musing is thinking deeply or pondering.

clue.text: Approve dreamland's near neighbour?

explanation.definitionFit: A nod signals assent, and the Land of Nod is sleep, close to the world of dreams.

clue.text: Eagle returning about Tyneside

indicators.note: returning means the short word for about is read backwards

parts.note: re means about, concerning
NE is North East England, where Tyneside lies

explanation.surface: A bird of prey flying back around Newcastle.
explanation.definitionFit: The erne is the white-tailed sea eagle.
